mapper.select: SELECT ps_id, warehouse_id, section_id, quantity, product_status FROM ProductStock WHERE ps_id = #{psId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ps.ps_id, ii.product_id, ps.warehouse_id, ps.section_id, ps.quantity, ps.product_status FROM ProductStock ps INNER JOIN InboundItem ii ON ps.inbound_item_id = ii.inbound_item_id WHERE ps.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND ii.product_id = #{productId} AND ps.quantity > 0 ORDER BY ps.ps_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ProductStock SET quantity = #{quantity}, last_update_date = NOW() WHERE ps_id = #{psId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ProductStockLog ( ps_id, event_time, move_quantity, event_type, product_status, destination ) VALUES ( #{psId}, NOW(), #{moveQuantity}, #{eventType}, #{productStatus}, #{destination} )
